sectors.title: Microsoft outage shows the risks of relying on a single technology provider for essential services
sectors.summary: Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Teams and AI assistant Copilot, were interrupted. But the company also warned that "intermittent access issues or delayed email delivery" may persist for some users.
